evidence.quote: The evaluation covers 425 instances across C/C++, Go, Python, and JavaScript, but does not represent all vulnerability classes, software architectures, or deployment environments.

Pretraining contamination in proprietary LLMs cannot be fully ruled out, but ContraFix’s 29.5–42.0 point gains over same-backbone GPT-5-mini baselines and its DeepSeek-V3.2 result make backbone memorization unlikely to explain the relative improvements.
These benchmark oracles are not complete semantic specifications.
ContraFix derives each RepairSpec from a finite set of generated executions, so the inferred relation may not cover the full input space.
ContraFix also fails to produce any benchmark-validated patch for 16 instances, including 9 root-cause tracing failures and 7 incomplete candidate repairs.
As reported in Section 4.1, 77 benchmark-validated patches are not semantically correct, including 44 incomplete/PoC-specific and 33 behavior-regressive patches.
